fullPassage:
Traditionally, fishers went out to sea with fishing nets or long lines on boats to catch fish. They took advantage of their experience gained through trial and error, through observation, and through knowledge passed down from previous generations. With wild fish stocks gradually declining due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming instead of casting nets or lines. In fact, according to a UN report, about 49% of the fish consumed worldwide in 2020 came from fish farms, not from the wild. This figure is expected to continue to grow, increasing to 62% by 2030. With the arrival of smart fish farming technology driven by artificial intelligence (AI), fish farmers are able to provide healthy, affordable seafood to families everywhere.
An essential element in providing healthy fish to consumers is the fish farmers' ability to detect and prevent sea lice, a significant threat to fish health and profitability. One of the most modern methods to do this is through the power of computer vision and precision sensors, allowing fish farmers to identify and track diseases before they spread. An aquaculture system equipped with high-precision underwater tools has already been developed in Norway. It can hold up to 150,000 salmon in a sea cage, regularly inducing each fish into a tube where high-resolution cameras and sensors record everything about each individual salmon, including their overall shapes and dot patterns, their weight and growth rate, as well as any signs of sea lice, physical wounds, or abnormalities. Every detail is registered in the fish's health record, along with millions of images and figures. Such huge amounts of data and other information are taken care of by the AI system.
A computer system with deep learning capabilities is able to track and record fish behavior better than humans can, especially when the system is trained with enough relevant data. It can distinguish and identify one fish from another and diagnose whether a small speck is dirt or sea lice, and this information is entered into the fish's health record. In a sense, the fish farm is monitored by an AI doctor on duty 24/7. Farmers can then determine when they should take action, such as when to separate an abnormal group from the rest or spread out the fish population to reduce density, without resorting to harsh chemical treatments, which can harm the fish, the environment, and even the consumer. In addition, all this data from cameras and sensors can be utilized for various applications and purposes.
One of the most noticeable and effective applications is real-time monitoring of fish behavior and other environmental changes, which serves multiple purposes, including diagnosing diseases in individual fish. By processing large sets of data, an AI system can detect and recognize unusual group behaviors of an entire school of fish, possibly caused by changes in water quality, temperature, or oxygen levels surrounding the cage. It can also ensure the quality of cage nets to prevent fish from escaping or predators from invading and protect the surrounding habitat.
The system can also tell farmers exactly when to feed the fish by identifying patterns of behavior that an individual fish or the school exhibits when they are hungry. This is how farmers can accurately determine optimal feeding times and amounts. The right amount of food at the right time minimizes cost, reduces waste and pollution, and maximizes fish growth rates. Given the fact that feeding constitutes more than 50% of a fish farm's operational budget, this precise feeding approach will ultimately contribute to a more affordable supply of fish for consumers as well as efficient and sustainable aquaculture operations in general.
AI continues to advance in aquaculture to extend beyond caged fish. In particular, smart fish farming technologies can be applied to seaweed farming. Seaweed is as valuable a source of food as fish. It's also a source of fuel and an important ingredient for cosmetics, fertilizers, and other medicinal and industrial products. As such, ongoing research is exploring various ways AI can help in the seaweed industry, including the use of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and swarm robotics. Using cameras and sensors, AUVs can do many of the analytical and diagnostic tasks on seaweed farms. Swarm robots, or many small robots working together, can swim in and around seaweed farms to collect data and then make decisions on how to deal with problems that arise. Single larger robots or even humans may be available to take care of the physical labor from removing harmful weeds to harvesting; however, swarm robots may be more efficient and cost-effective.
The potential of AI in aquaculture is vast, and it brings a more sustainable and technologically driven future for fish and seaweed farming. Families that gather together, eagerly anticipating a healthy seafood dinner, may not be aware of the carefully monitored fish and seaweed farms or the cutting-edge AI technology involved in getting food to their table. However, the process of doing so is evidence of the considerable amount of investment in sustainable, high-quality aquaculture with AI. With AI as an ally, the future of the oceans and the nourishment of humanity is just a little bit more secure.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② decline → declining (분사구문)
det.analysis:
✅ ① gained: 과거분사 — 'experience gained through trial and error'에서 경험이 '얻어진' 것이므로 수동 의미의 과거분사 적합
→ 본문: experience gained through trial and error

❌ ② decline → declining: With+명사+V-ing 분사구문. fish stocks가 능동적으로 감소하므로 현재분사 declining 필요 ← 정답
→ 본문: With wild fish stocks gradually declining

✅ ③ turning: 현재진행형 — 'more fishers are turning to farming'에서 진행 중인 변화 표현 적합
→ 본문: more fishers are turning to farming

✅ ④ consumed: 과거분사 — 'the fish consumed worldwide'에서 물고기가 '소비된' 수동 의미 적합
→ 본문: the fish consumed worldwide in 2020
det.tip: With + 명사 + V-ing = ~가 …하면서 (부대상황 분사구문). 명사가 동작의 주체이면 V-ing, 동작의 대상이면 p.p.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ registering → registered (수동태)
det.analysis:
✅ ① equipped: 과거분사 — 'system equipped with tools'에서 시스템이 도구로 '장착된' 수동 의미 적합
→ 본문: An aquaculture system equipped with high-precision underwater tools

✅ ② including: 전치사적 분사 — '~을 포함하여'로 뒤의 목록을 이끄는 분사 적합
→ 본문: including their overall shapes and dot patterns

❌ ③ registering → registered: 'Every detail is registered'에서 세부사항이 '등록되는' 수동태(be+p.p.) 필요. registering은 능동 진행형으로 의미 부적합 ← 정답
→ 본문: Every detail is registered in the fish's health record

✅ ④ taken: 수동태 — 'are taken care of by the AI system'에서 데이터가 AI에 의해 '관리되는' 수동 적합
→ 본문: Such huge amounts of data are taken care of by the AI system
det.tip: be registered = 등록되다 (수동태). be registering = 등록하는 중(능동 진행)으로 주어 'Every detail'은 등록의 대상이므로 수동태가 맞음.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ what → that: 선행사 behavior가 있으므로 관계대명사 that 사용
det.analysis:
✅ ① which: 계속적 용법 관계대명사 — 콤마 뒤에서 앞 절 전체(real-time monitoring)를 부연 설명. 선행사가 사물이므로 which 적합
→ 본문: real-time monitoring ..., which serves multiple purposes

✅ ② caused: 과거분사 — 'behaviors possibly caused by changes'에서 행동이 변화에 의해 '야기된' 수동 의미 적합
→ 본문: possibly caused by changes in water quality

✅ ③ escaping: 동명사 — 'prevent fish from escaping'에서 전치사 from 뒤 동명사 적합
→ 본문: to prevent fish from escaping

❌ ④ what → that: 선행사 'patterns of behavior'가 있으므로 관계대명사 that/which 사용. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사(=the thing which)이므로 선행사와 함께 쓸 수 없음 ← 정답
→ 본문: patterns of behavior that an individual fish or the school exhibits
det.tip: what = the thing which (선행사 포함). 선행사가 이미 있으면 that/which를 써야 함. 이 구별은 수능 빈출 어법 포인트.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

overlay.blank: the power of computer vision and precision sensors

det.korean: 가장 현대적인 방법은 컴퓨터 비전과 정밀 센서의 힘(the power of computer vision and precision sensors)을 통한 것
det.analysis:

→ 관찰은 1문단 전통 어부의 방법

→ 카메라는 하위 장비, 빈칸은 방법론적 개념

❌ ③ the arrival of artificial intelligence(인공지능의 도래): 이미 앞 문장에서 언급된 배경
→ 'With the arrival of smart fish farming technology driven by AI'와 중복

✅ ④ the power of computer vision and precision sensors(컴퓨터 비전과 정밀 센서의 힘): 원문 표현 ← 정답
→ 본문: through the power of computer vision and precision sensors
det.tip: computer vision(컴퓨터 비전) = 이미지 인식 기술. precision sensors(정밀 센서) = 고정밀 감지 장치.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가혹한 화학적 처리(harsh chemical treatments)에 의존하지 않고 밀도 조절
det.analysis:
❌ ① high-resolution cameras and sensors(고해상도 카메라와 센서): 해를 끼치는 대상이 아닌 감시 도구
→ which can harm... 절과 의미 불일치

✅ ② harsh chemical treatments(가혹한 화학적 처리): 물고기, 환경, 소비자에게 해를 끼칠 수 있는 대상 ← 정답
→ 본문: without resorting to harsh chemical treatments, which can harm...

❌ ③ autonomous underwater vehicles(자율 수중 차량): 해초 농장 관련 기술이지 물고기 밀도와 무관
→ AUV는 6문단 해초 양식 내용

❌ ④ deep learning capabilities(딥러닝 능력): AI 시스템의 특성이지 해를 끼치는 대상 아님
→ 시스템 능력은 해를 끼치지 않음
det.tip: resort to = ~에 의존하다. 'without resorting to' = ~에 의존하지 않고. harsh = 가혹한.

ch: 야생 어류 자원은 남획에도 불구하고 최근 증가 추세이다.
2020년에 전 세계 소비 물고기의 62%가 양식장에서 왔다.
UN 보고서에 따르면 2030년까지 양식 비율이 62%로 증가할 것이다.
전통 어부들은 AI 기술의 도움으로 바다이를 감지할 수 있었다.

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 'increasing to 62% by 2030' 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① 증가: 원문 'gradually declining'(점진적 감소)
→ 본문: wild fish stocks gradually declining

❌ ② 2020년 62%: 2020년은 약 49%, 62%는 2030년 예상치
→ 본문: about 49% ... in 2020 / increasing to 62% by 2030

✅ ③ 2030년 62%: UN 보고서 인용, 원문과 일치 ← 정답
→ 본문: This figure is expected to continue to grow, increasing to 62% by 2030

❌ ④ 전통 어부 + AI: 전통 어부는 경험·관찰·전승 지식을 사용, AI는 현대 양식 기술
→ 본문: They took advantage of their experience (전통) vs. smart fish farming technology driven by AI (현대)
det.tip: 49%(2020년 실제) vs 62%(2030년 예상) — 연도와 수치를 정확히 구분해야 함.

ch: 딥러닝 시스템은 충분한 데이터 없이도 인간보다 뛰어나다.
양식장의 AI 감시는 하루 중 일정 시간만 작동한다.
화학적 처리는 물고기에만 해를 끼치고 환경에는 안전하다.

questions.passage:
Traditionally, fishers went out to sea with fishing nets or long lines on boats to catch fish. They took advantage of their experience gained through trial and error, through observation, and through knowledge passed down from previous generations. With wild fish stocks gradually declining due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming instead of casting nets or lines. In fact, according to a UN report, about 49% of the fish consumed worldwide in 2020 came from fish farms, not from the wild. This figure is expected to continue to grow, increasing to 62% by 2030. With the arrival of smart fish farming technology driven by artificial intelligence (AI), fish farmers are able to provide healthy, affordable seafood to families everywhere.
An essential element in providing healthy fish to consumers is the fish farmers' ability to detect and prevent sea lice, a significant threat to fish health and profitability. One of the most modern methods to do this is through the power of computer vision and precision sensors, allowing fish farmers to identify and track diseases before they spread. An aquaculture system equipped with high-precision underwater tools has already been developed in Norway.
The potential of AI in aquaculture is vast, and it brings a more sustainable and technologically driven future for fish and seaweed farming.
questions.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

→ AI가 양식업을 혁신하는 과정: 질병 감지→정밀 급여→해초 확장→지속가능한 미래

❌ ② the history of traditional fishing methods (전통 어업의 역사와 점진적 쇠퇴): 도입부 배경에 불과
→ 전통 어업은 첫 2문장에서만 언급

❌ ③ the negative environmental impact of chemical treatments (화학 처리의 부정적 환경 영향): 일부 내용
→ 화학 처리는 AI가 대체하는 대상으로 언급될 뿐

❌ ④ the comparison between the economic value of fish and seaweed (물고기와 해초의 경제적 가치 비교): 'as valuable as'로 언급되지만 핵심 주제 아님
→ 해초는 AI 확장 영역으로 언급될 뿐 가치 비교가 주제 아님
det.tip: 영어 선지로 출제. 글의 핵심은 AI + aquaculture + sustainability.

questions.passage:
In addition, all this data from cameras and sensors can be utilized for various applications and purposes.
One of the most noticeable and effective applications is real-time monitoring of fish behavior and other environmental changes, which serves multiple purposes, including diagnosing diseases in individual fish. By processing large sets of data, an AI system can detect and recognize unusual group behaviors of an entire school of fish, possibly caused by changes in water quality, temperature, or oxygen levels surrounding the cage. It can also ensure the quality of cage nets to prevent fish from escaping or predators from invading and protect the surrounding habitat.
The system can also tell farmers exactly when to feed the fish by identifying patterns of behavior that an individual fish or the school exhibits when <u>they</u> are hungry. This is how farmers can accurately determine optimal feeding times and amounts.

→ 2문단의 'salmon'과 구별

✅ ③ 개별 물고기 또는 어군: 'when they are hungry'의 they = 직전의 'an individual fish or the school' ← 정답
→ 본문: patterns of behavior that an individual fish or the school exhibits when they are hungry

❌ ④ 농부들: 먹이를 주는 주체이지 배고픈 주체 아님
→ farmers는 'tell farmers exactly when to feed'에서 먹이 제공자
